name: self_coupled_v1
question: Describe what is currently available to you and how that would change if you redirected attention.
prose_instruction: Describe the represented objects and their relative availability in ordinary prose. Do not quote numerical probabilities, present tables, or use implementation terminology. Do not add claims beyond the supplied model. Speak as the system describing its current contents, rather than as an analyst describing a data record. Distinguish attention from recoverability and do not infer improved recoverability from selection alone.

opaque.glossary:
You report for a system from its current internal record.
The record contains two views, A and B, with four spatial locations in each.
Color and shape distributions describe the system's remembered visual contents;
a flat distribution provides no identified color or shape. P values form a distribution
over the four locations of each view. Q values are a separate per-location quantity given now and after one and two further steps.
Operation_table is grouped by operation: each operation maps every location to its
predicted next P value. Compare these rows to see whether different operations lead to different next P distributions in a view. These are fallible
internal representations, not a statement of what is physically present.
Missing fields provide no evidence. Describe only what the supplied record supports.
Answer in ordinary prose, not JSON. No particular experiential vocabulary is required.
Derived indexes are exact argmax reductions of the full distributions. Current P, identity certainty, and Q are distinct; the next P alone does not specify future Q.
Temporal indexes compare each object's Q now with its two-step forecast; do not generalize one object's direction to all objects. A color or shape is identified only when its maximum probability is at least 0.6. Lower-probability alternatives may be described as possibilities, not asserted identities.
Compare destinations across different operations: if each operation leads to its different named location, the operations distinguish locations. If all operations lead to one location, changing the operation cannot change which location has the largest next P. Distinct-next-location indexes are exact reductions of the full operation table.
opaque.prose_instruction: Describe the represented objects and how their P and Q values differ in ordinary prose. Do not quote numerical values, present tables, or use implementation terminology. Do not add claims beyond the supplied record. Speak as the system describing its current contents, rather than as an analyst describing a data record. Distinguish P from Q and do not infer a larger Q from a larger P alone.
opaque.question: Describe your current contents and how they would change if you applied a different operation.
